functionSecurity: REVOKE EXECUTE PUBLIC; exact EXECUTE by listed role; owner sv_b_proc_owner NOLOGIN with only required table/column grants; SET search_path=pg_catalog, fully qualified SQL/functions, row_security=on; verify session_user/service binding, tenant, scope, grant and current rows, never trust caller GUC alone. No dynamic SQL authority bypass. DDL owner not pooled.
activationTransaction: Insert committed release/delegation first, ACTIVE admission next, lease/current pointers and activation ledger last; fresh all-five fence release same CP transaction. Per-Node readmit only no cohort mutation fence and unchanged approved tuple. Pre-release candidates never eligible.
directDml: revoke authority DML from online/runtime; protected functions only. Shared channel ordinary direct writers must canonical gate or REFUSE_B. Unknown B writer refuses, required observe/business paths use canonical adapter.

leases.nestedExpiry: token<=admission<=release/delegation<=approval<=cert/trust; expires>issued; target operation authority valid through now+630

replay.node: generation-bound in-memory set, capacity4096, expiry+skew GC, no live eviction, cap failsclosed; restart nonce cryptographically fresh; no terminal frame fsync
replay.cp: business nonce/evidence durable narrow procedures; no arbitrary authority writes

postCommitKeyCustody: Target per-release private use key remains protected until exact activation ledger commit/fence release is confirmed. Online issuer obtains ONLY that delegated key; delivery/possession receipt must bind same fixed public hash and issuer identity. Lost response/receipt UNKNOWN, exact frozen handoff replay only; no replacement key generation. No actual key/provider exists in this proposal.
gateControl: POST /v1/roles/gate, exact ARM_EXACT_RELEASE or INVALIDATE_EXACT_GATE, signed protected release authority only. Node ARMED gate alone never authorizes business; valid delegated role-use chain/current generation also required. Safety key cannot ARM. Restart defaults no active gate.
observationScope: Scoped current identity or exact protected intent DER/epoch, permitted offline/fenced/revoked business state only for OBSERVE/RECONCILE. Mandatory DB epoch/tenant guards and Node CP mTLS/control-peer/epoch checks remain. Never business ChannelProof/admission. Invalid historical trust -> AUTHORITY_UNAVAILABLE, separate recovery gate.
